reviews.title: Great card, you need good ventilation and newest drivers.
reviews.comment:
For gaming this is a great card. My case isn't best for thermals and coupled with how hot these run anyway I had to mod a fan directly in front of the GPU to disperse heat from setting at the bottom of the case and the GPU itself.
With this 1 mod and playing the New Warzone game at full 1080p high/ultra everything.
Temps: 60-70c
GPU usage 50-70%
Consistently running at 140-150fps during gameplay. 200-900fps during cutscenes (which is nuts).
The newest driver update fixed all the weird anomolies and any crashing I was having occasionally.
If you start getting thermal clocked just put a 120mm to 140mm fan facing directly on top of the GPU and it will help immensely assuming you have good exhaust ventilation. Or if you're not cheap buy a water cooler and mod the GPU yourself. It's your warranty if you do that though!
reviews.author: Tim Stafford

reviews.title: Not impressed with drivers.
reviews.comment:
I swapped out a 590 for this card, and yes, now I can crank up the details on Assassins Creed Odyssey... but not near as far as I expected.  And, at the same time, with the same Radeon drivers installed, I'm getting all kinds of ugly graphical glitches.  All kinds of tearing, textures getting dropped, and when in the caves in ACO there is all kinds of full screen flashing going on, like reflections run amok.
One good thing I can say about this card in particular is that it is nice and quiet, compared to my old Powercolor 590, which always sounded like a jet.
Not impressed at all... Considering trading over to the green team.
